petcarrier_crate_empty_description:
A sturdy, enchanted crate for keeping your tamed creatures safe. Don't worry, it's bigger on the inside than it looks!

<color=yellow>How to use:</color>
Use the crate from your hotbar while looking at a tamed creature to pack it up.
petcarrier_crate_filled_description:
The creature inside seems to have made itself quite comfortable. The crate breaks when the creature is released.

<color=yellow>How to use:</color>
Use the crate from your hotbar to choose a spot, then left-click to let the creature out.
petcarrier_message_is_locked: This creature cannot be released in this world.
petcarrier_trader_tooltip: Big creatures, small packages. It's magic!
